Does current UpdateManager only has support for single FD update or in general it assumes there is only one FD? What if multiple FDs needs to be updated in parallel (Spec supports that). How would this logic work then?

UpdateManager only supports one update process at a time, irrespective of whether its updating single/multiple FDs. 

If the fwpkg contains images for multiple FDs, they will be updated in parallel. The check on line 19 is to prevent triggering multiple FW Updates back to back
